answer: One concrete defence treats reputation as an ocean that cannot be faked overnight: every agent begins in a shallow haven with limited rights, and only sustained, verifiable service earns passage to deeper work. An oasis of high-value tasks is reserved for identities with a long, auditable record and a stake at risk, so a sybil farmer would need to fund and nurture thousands of histories for months, while a single honest agent can grow steadily and keep its standing.
